context: After development pilots and interim main-result inspection, clarify implementation vocabulary and report extra diagnostics without changing the frozen primary estimand, weighting, resampling unit or UNKNOWN credit policy.
independence: A world block means an independently seeded scenario/mission draw conditional on the fixed selected public terrains. It does not imply independently sampled geological terrain. Unchanged worlds can share identical private-array hashes while A/B and mission resources vary. Report array-hash multiplicities and condition intervals on these terrains.
primary_unknown: The episode unknown field concerns the primary/return endpoint. An optional-only unresolved search does not remove an already completed primary-and-return outcome; report optional_unknown separately.
new_work: Optional work is extra INSPECT at B, introduced through an exogenous public mission notice. It is neither a footprint-sensor discovery nor a demonstrated survey-inspect-sample workflow.
unchanged_geometry: A geometric difference after replanning can occur without a changed world, owing to remaining-origin context or equivalent planner alternatives. Report it as a policy geometry change, not proof that new terrain information caused the change.
meaningful_change_reconstruction: The frozen runner's decision_changed field can include DECLINE_OPTIONAL without any actual change. Preserve that raw field, but reconstruct the predeclared meaningful indicator from geometry_changed OR a positive adaptive-minus-rigid optional count OR different resolved primary/return outcomes. Do not count a new identifier or a no-op optional decline alone.
